title: Set HTTP/HTTPS proxy via environment variables
summary: Configure the current shell session to use a proxy server by setting standard environment variables. This affects command-line tools like curl, wget, and pacman.
prerequisites: Know your proxy server address and port.

steps.explain: Set the HTTP proxy variable. Replace <PROXY_URL> with your proxy address (e.g., http://10.203.0.1:5187/).

placeholders.name: PROXY_URL
placeholders.description: The full URL of the proxy server, including protocol and port.

steps.explain: Set the HTTPS proxy variable to the same value as HTTP.
Set the FTP proxy variable to the same value as HTTP.
Set the no_proxy variable to exclude local addresses from using the proxy.
